title: He Banned Email. The Task Board Remembered Everything.
script: My manager announced that email created too much confusion, so every assignment had to be spoken aloud and added to the shared task board. No exceptions. This was mostly because his emails kept contradicting each other. Fine. I started creating a card after every conversation, quoting the deadline and tagging him as requester. He approved each card without reading it. On Friday, he told me to delay a client shipment until Monday. Monday arrived, the client complained, and he told our director I had ignored an urgent Friday deadline. I opened the board during the meeting. His approved card said, word for word, hold shipment until Monday. Then I scrolled. Six more cards showed the same pattern. The room got very quiet. Even the notification bell seemed nervous. The director restored email that afternoon and made every deadline require written approval. My manager still hates the task board. It remembers him perfectly.
